pair.noDimmersFound: No dimmers found. The app supports only the first generation (@ND), not SG Smart 3.0. Close the SG Smart app on your phone and try again closer to a dimmer. If that does not help, send a diagnostics report right away: Settings, Apps, SG LEDDim.
pair.allAlreadyAdded: All the dimmers found have already been added.

members.title: Dimmers in this group
members.hint: Tick the dimmers this group should drive. They must already be added as dimmers in Homey.
members.none: No dimmers have been added yet. Add your dimmers first, then add a group.

search.title: Searching for dimmers
search.noneText: The app supports only the first generation (@ND), not SG Smart 3.0. Close the SG Smart app on your phone and try again closer to a dimmer. If that does not help, right away press "Create diagnostics report" on the app page, below Configure.
search.failedText: Try again in a moment. The error was: "__error__"

keepConnected.label: Keep dimmers connected
keepConnected.hint: Faster control, and wall switch changes show up right away. With only one dimmer, the SG app can't connect at the same time.

signal.title: Signal to Homey
signal.hint: Only the dimmer showing "Direct" needs a good signal. If it is weak, move Homey closer to one of the dimmers.

otherDevice.title: Other SG devices
otherDevice.hint: Have another SG device named @NDxxxx? Try to add it and use it a little. Then right away press "Create diagnostics report" on the app page, below Configure.

troubleshooting.title: Troubleshooting
troubleshooting.hint: Only when the developer asks for it. Turn it off again before you send a diagnostics report.

device.notHeard: No status from the dimmer. Wrong password, or out of range?
device.waitingForStatus: Waiting for the dimmer's first status.
device.passwordWrong: Possibly wrong network password. See settings.

notification.passwordWrong: Possibly wrong network password in SG LEDDim. Check whether Network Isolation is on in the SG app. Turn it off, or enter the right password in the settings of every dimmer.
